messages:
jess (devex): Quick PSA — SDK 6.0 is out now. Heads-up: a couple of breaking changes around auth, retries, and streaming. Please report blockers for your language stacks.

samir (sdk): Thanks — main changes: 1) AUTH env var renamed, 2) retry API is policy-first (no global config), 3) streaming emits explicit chunk types.

leila (eng): Which auth env var was renamed? I have CI that expects REDWOOD_API_KEY.

samir (sdk): Good call — REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN. We left backwards compat for one minor release but it's removed in 6.0. Recommend search/replace in CI and k8s secrets.

leila (eng): Got it. Can we do a quick grep patch? Example: `s/REDWOOD_API_KEY/REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN/g` in infra repo.

kevin (platform): FYI platform infra will expose both for 48h via an alias secret to reduce blast radius. We'll announce cutover window.

jess (devex): Also: retry behaviour changed. Old: client.retry(maxAttempts: 3). New: client.addRetryPolicy({ type: 'idempotent', max: 3, backoff: 'jittered' }). Quick Qs: does this affect any of our integrations?

leila (eng): Our payment path uses low-level retry hooks. We'll need to swap to the policy interface. Any helper for translating old configs?

samir (sdk): There's a migration helper in the release: `migrateRetries(oldConfig)` in utils. Short example: ```js // node
// old
client.retry({ maxAttempts: 2 })
// new
client.addRetryPolicy({ type: 'idempotent', max: 2 })
```

leila (eng): Great — where is that helper? npm package or repo?

samir (sdk): It's in the sdk-utils package (npm:@redwood/sdk-utils@6.0.0). We'll publish a codemod soon.

jess (devex): Streaming changes: prior behavior emitted raw token strings. 6.0 emits typed events: `data`, `chunk_end`, `error`, `done`. Node/Browser clients expose an event emitter. Python yields Event objects.

kevin (platform): Any breaking change for long-polling / server-side SSE proxies? We've got nginx buffering that can screw with event boundaries.

samir (sdk): Yes — because we emit explicit `chunk_end`, proxies that coalesce events can merge chunks incorrectly. Workaround: set `proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` for nginx. We'll document.

release-bot: release | 1769456790 | SDK 6.0 published to npm/pypi. Changelog: https://internal.redwood.dev/sdk/6.0-changelog

leila (eng): Node specific: any changes to streaming API? We use async iterators currently.

samir (sdk): Node still supports async iterators but now yields `{ type, payload }` instead of raw strings. Example: ```js for await (const ev of client.stream(...)) { if (ev.type === 'data') process(ev.payload) } ```

leila (eng): Ok we'll update our parser. Anything else language-specific?

samir (sdk): Python: renamed `StreamChunk` -> `StreamEvent`. Go: client constructors now require `WithToken()` option (instead of reading env automatically).

jess (devex): Action items: 1) infra to set alias secret (kevin), 2) eng teams to update retries and streaming usage (leila + others), 3) devex to publish migration guide and codemod (jess/samir). Please ping here if you hit a blocker.

kevin (platform): Will create a short runbook and open a PR to inject alias for 48h. ETA EOD PT.

leila (eng): We'll run tests against 6.0 in staging tomorrow and post results here.

samir (sdk): If you see auth errors, look for 401 + header `x-rw-auth-migration: missing-token` — quick indicator you still use the old env.

jess (devex): Thanks all. I'll drop a minimal checklist in #docs and link the codemod once published. :thumbsup:

leila (eng): One small runtime quirk: our worker process saw higher memory during streaming. Any known leaks?

samir (sdk): Not leaks — streaming now buffers metadata objects per-chunk. You can reduce memory by enabling `streaming.smallObjectMode: true` in client options. We'll add to FAQ.

release-bot: infra | 1769460123 | Cutover alias secret created for staging (expires in 48h).
